cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Ask the director why the overtime rule changed. I'll support you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Your fresh perspective won't carry my disciplinary history.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand beside me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just behind. Where supportive people remain employable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask the director why the overtime rule changed. I'll support you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your fresh perspective won't carry my disciplinary history.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand beside me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just behind. Where supportive people remain employable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule at tonight's club meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask him to restore your booking as well. I'll draft both requests for your speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then sign it. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave space for my signature. Once he's agreed you have a point, call me up to add it.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then give me a separate introduction when I welcome the staff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner's doing the welcome. You offered to serve burgers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce the burger service: 'Director Patel will serve you.' I'd like them to hear who's making this gesture.

cards.title: The Only Professional

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your location, Morgan's budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call it a compromise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you wear my ribbon or Nina's for the chess club election?

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

beats.speaker: B
